name: mcp-kicad
description: Design KiCad schematics and routed PCBs by talking to Claude, checked by KiCad's own ERC and DRC.
long_description: Describe a circuit in plain language and get back a real `.kicad_sch` you can open and edit in KiCad, then a placed and routed two-layer `.kicad_pcb` and the Gerbers to manufacture it. Every schematic is verified before you see it: no wire crosses a foreign net, no wire runs through a component body, every declared connection exists and no accidental ones do. Every board is checked by KiCad's DRC with schematic parity; a board that fails is never handed over as if it were fine. Requires KiCad 10 installed; `kicad-cli` is detected automatically.
